processing_notes: PDS4 XML sidecar is the inspected source for raster shape, encoding, missing constant, georeference and coverage.
USGS product record describes a 20 m/pixel CTX DEM mosaic assembled from stereo pairs; it includes an original TRN DEM and added Ames Stereo Pipeline DEMs.
The product record says added DEMs were vertically localized to MOLA and some horizontal georeferencing was performed in ArcGIS Pro.
No raster values were read in this metadata validation; the complete GeoTIFF was not downloaded.

Application-compatible geo representation is equirectangular with center_lat_deg=0, center_lon_deg=0, standard_parallel_deg=18.4663, origin_x_m=4329000 and origin_y_m=1143420; this is metadata only and has not been run through the terrain importer.
